title: Derived descent for a representable hypercover of a site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with finite limits [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention], let $X\in\mathcal C$, and let $U_\bullet\to X$ be a simplicial object of $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] with an augmentation (a natural map to the constant object $X$). Put $M_0=X$, and for $n>0$ let $M_n$ be the finite matching limit in $\mathcal C/X$ of all compatible proper faces of an $n$-simplex. Suppose the sieve generated by $U_n\to M_n$ is covering for every $n\ge0$. Give every slice $\mathcal C/U_n$ and $\mathcal C/X$ its induced topology. Let $b:\mathrm{Sh}((\mathcal C/U_\bullet)_{total})\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C/X)$ be the augmentation geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. Here the total topos has sheaves given by families $F_n$ on the slices and maps $u_\alpha^{-1}F_p\to F_q$ for every structure map $u_\alpha:U_q\to U_p$, satisfying the identity and composition rules. For every $E\in D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(\mathcal C/X))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the ordinary derived adjunction unit
$$E\longrightarrow Rb_*b^{-1}E$$
is an isomorphism.
